docs: Claim token rewards – factory sends funds, staking validates state

instructions.name: deploy_mixer
docs: Deploy a new mixer instance for a specific mode and amount

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit into a mixer pool – funds stay in factory vaults, mixer manages only state (CPI)

docs: Get mixer config address for a specific mode and amount

docs: Initialize the factory and its main vaults

docs: Initialize the first stake season (called after initialize_staking)

docs: Stake SOL – factory holds funds, staking manages state

instructions.name: stake_token
docs: Stake tokens – factory holds funds, staking manages state

docs: Start a new stake season (admin function)

instructions.name: unstake_sol
docs: Unstake SOL – factory sends funds, staking updates state

instructions.name: unstake_token
docs: Unstake tokens – factory sends funds, staking updates state

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw from a mixer pool – factory sends funds, mixer validates state (CPI)
